cats.label: Overview
cats.title: Two dashboards. One source of truth.
cats.sub: A modern KPI dashboard for answering questions, plus a classic tree-table for auditing rows. Everything shown in BDT.

items.d: Date-range presets · Sales / Customer / Stock / Revenue tiles · Orders & Profit sparklines.
Collapses 13 raw delivery states into 5 buckets with a per-status legend.
Green earnings vs. red expenses — exposes "good revenue / bad month" instantly.
Cash account events with auto-mapped icons, ranked by gross revenue.
Expandable rows reveal full order objects — answer "where is order 5421?" in two clicks.
Tiles vanish entirely for roles without `Sales Report View` — no greyed-out teases.

cats.label: Sales
cats.title: From phone-call to dispatched parcel.
cats.sub: The order workhorse: capture social-commerce sales, manage them in bulk, and print a thermal or A4 invoice in one click.

items.d: Phone-search auto-creates customers · variant-aware picker · COD / Bkash / Nagad / SSL Commerze / Cash · live totals.
Quick tabs (Paid / Delivered / Unpaid / Partial) · search · bulk courier assignment · bulk invoices.
Editable status dropdowns · payment history · billing + shipping addresses · customer order history — all on one page.
Pre-filled OrderForm · payment method locked once cleared · live total recalculation.
Tree-table with per-column filtering — accountants reconcile end-of-month without dev access.
A4 ↔ POS toggle · prints multiple orders from `?orderIds=1,2,3` · default format reads from Shop Settings.
Lifetime spend per row · Tag column drives VIP / wholesale / churned segments · search.
8 clickable stat tiles drill into pre-filtered Order Management · addresses + 5-row order history.

cats.label: Catalog
cats.title: Inventory, batches, warehouses — one schema.
cats.sub: Variants roll up into one listing. Batches power expiry. Damage and Return pages keep shrinkage honest.

items.d: 3-level tree (Category → Sub → Sub-Sub) · status toggle archives seasonal collections.
Variant-aware stock column · status badges · sortable by date / price / stock / popularity.
Simple or Variation type · Cost vs. Unit price · low-stock alert threshold · drag-drop gallery (max 2MB).
Locked SKUs prevent duplicates · per-image delete · per-variant Add Stock modal.
4 stock tiles (Current / Return / Sold / Damage) · Stock History gated on `stock.view`.
Manufacturing + expiry dates per lot · mandatory for pharmacy, food, cosmetics merchants.
Multi-location with manager contacts · Transfer Products modal logs inter-warehouse moves.
One submit · per-variant warehouse routing · supplier PO reference · auto-cache invalidation.
Every write-off logged with reason + warehouse — spot pattern losses across locations.
4-state pipeline: Pending → Approved → Completed / Rejected · partial refunds split Returned vs Non-Return items.

cats.label: Marketing
cats.title: Built for Facebook-first commerce.

items.d: Card grid · sort Newest / Oldest · filter Imported vs Created · search.
Two-column form + template gallery · multi-product picker shows live qty · SEO title + description required.
Pre-populated builder · per-image remove · spin variants of a winning page in minutes.

cats.label: Finance
cats.title: Your CFO, on call.
cats.sub: Wallet + real cash + business totals on one screen. Refund rate as a leading quality signal. Append-only audit log.

items.d: 6 wallet cards · 4 real-cash cards · 4 business cards · Recent Audit Log surfaces sketchy edits.
Type breakdown table · stat cards (Credits, Debits, Net) · view modal with diff fields.
Daily / Weekly / Monthly grouped bar chart · Manual entries (Cash In / Cash Out) for register reconciliation.
Animated category breakdown · 8 built-in buckets (refund / shipping / SMS / marketing / …) + custom.
Refund-rate stat · status workflow · refund code per ticket — a leading quality indicator.
Append-only · stat cards (Events, Unique Users, Unique IPs) · click any row for full event payload.
Overview + Details tabs · Sales-by-Status horizontal bar · Top 5 deals · combo column+line chart.
8 tiles (Available, In, Out, Sold, Damage, Return, Low-Stock, Stock Value) · multi-axis line + per-SKU details.
Profit % per variant · 11 time-period presets · multi-product picker · auto-relabeling sort order.
Coming soon — repeat rate, lifetime value, cohort analysis (backend ready).

items.d: Manage your shop profile, business details, and branding from one place — with changes synced instantly across your dashboard.
Create and update all your essential business and legal pages — including Privacy Policy, FAQ, Contact, and Refund Policy — with ease.
Stock validation toggle · partial payment % or ৳ cap · default invoice (POS / A4) · default courier.
Server-side Facebook CAPI · GTM server URL · GA4 Measurement Protocol — survives cookie deprecation.
Steadfast + Pathao credential cards · webhook URL + auth-token copy-to-clipboard.
Multi-role staff directory · password show/hide · onboard a packer in 90 seconds.
Master Select-All · per-group toggle · 200-permission system stays manageable.
Active plan + invoice history · trial-status flag · success state on.
Plan-comparison cards in BDT · auto-redirect for already-subscribed users · checkout via SSL Commerze.
Total Earning · Account Balance · Growth Rate · Dues — focused alternative to full Accounting Overview.
Auto-filled withdrawable balance · free-text method (bank / wallet / cheque) · max-balance guard.
